card.name: Words before something to be protected
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, the, in) or verbs like avoid, copy, damage, undercut, right after a harm or avoidance cue and just before the thing being affected or protected.

modes.label: Linking word after harm noun
modes.description: "of" or "in" after a noun for loss, reversal, interference or deaths, before the affected thing.
modes.example: additional administration is not required and may actually be harmful due to unwanted reversal<< of>> analgesia or precipitated withdrawal.

modes.label: "the" after avoid
modes.description: "the" after "Avoid" in skin-product directions, before body areas like eyes and mouth.
modes.example: Avoid<< the>> eyes, lips, and mucous membranes

modes.label: Verb of harming or undermining
modes.description: Verbs like undercut or damage that come before the thing that could be harmed.
modes.example: it would not<< damage>> economic plants.

card.writes: Seems to push toward words about preserving or protecting things (integrity, preserve, dignity) and away from decay words.
card.plain: It fires on little words and verbs that come just before the thing being harmed, avoided or kept intact.
